tool_repair.issue: Saved summaries could substitute for command execution without run identity binding
tool_repair.resolution: Removed reusable resume mode entirely; public qualification always executes its commands and refuses prior step evidence before starting. Saved OK text or a stale receipt cannot be promoted.
tool_repair.new_regression: Removed resume CLI rejects unrelated OK log and stale receipt; direct qualifier refusal occurs before subprocess execution and preserves prior evidence bytes.
